module_budget_change: Bump up the budget to 400 for now. There will be multiple PRs that will decrease the budget by 50. Each time the budget is hit you will make a change to decompose the files, until the budget of 250 is achieved. (maintainer, 2026-11-26)
description: holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json now sets default_max_lines to 400 with ratchet-down overrides only for modules above 400. The maintainer's schedule lowers the default by 50 per pull request until 250. Six source modules without an override sit between 351 and 400 lines and must be decomposed before the default can drop to 350: apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/wisdom.py (353), apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/budgets.py (359), apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/git_refs.py (380), scripts/pre_commit_check.py (381), apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/cli/commands/flow.py (398), and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/github/ci_final_head.py (368). Re-measured on origin/main; no other source module is over 350 lines without an override (cli/__init__.py is exactly 350 and is within the limit).
goal: Step 2 of the schedule: split each of the six modules into focused modules of at most 350 lines (move-only where possible; keep every public import path working through re-exports in the original module; no logic in __init__.py), then set default_max_lines to 350 in holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Keep every override above 400 exactly as it is (ratchet-down only; none raised or added) and the exclude list unchanged. Update the test and the docs/architecture.md section that state the default. Behaviour must not change. Split guidance (planner, not optional): wisdom.py keeps promote_pending_candidates and the evaluate_action_promotion call in place (tests patch sandbox_executor.knowledge.wisdom.evaluate_action_promotion); budgets.py keeps load_budgets and the Budgets types and moves the stage-timer machinery to budgets_timer.py; flow/git_refs.py keeps every function that calls run_git or _append_ledger_row (tests patch sandbox_executor.flow.git_refs.run_git, _append_ledger_row, _fetch_branch_prefix and workspace_mounted on that module, so those callers must stay there), and moves only helpers that do not reach a patched name; scripts/pre_commit_check.py must still run as `python3 scripts/pre_commit_check.py --staged` (sibling imports must work both run directly and as scripts.pre_commit_check); cli/commands/flow.py keeps register and run, and test_patch_targets requires tests to patch the owning module. Every name that any test imports or patches from an original module path stays importable from that path (re-export), so no test file needs editing; any test edit beyond import-path updates is out of scope and must not be made. flow/lazy_exports.py is in scope only so the owner map can point moved names at their new module if needed. ci_final_head.py (368 lines, split guidance, planner not optional): check_final_head_ci, format_final_head_ci, classify_final_head, _classify_settled, _wait_for_ci_registration and the GitHubAdapter name stay in ci_final_head.py (tests patch sandbox_executor.flow.github.ci_final_head.GitHubAdapter and ci_final_head._wait_for_ci_registration). Move the seam types FinalHeadSeams and _FinalHeadCheck to flow/github/ci_final_head_seams.py, and move the timing-rerun helpers (_git_changed_paths, _bookkeeping_only, _code_unchanged, _timing_gate_only, _failed_run_ids, _eligible_run_ids, _rerun_timing_once) to flow/github/ci_final_head_rerun.py. The rerun and seams modules must never import ci_final_head (no import cycle). ci_final_head.py re-exports every name that another module or test imports from it (BOOKKEEPING_PATH_PREFIXES, _bookkeeping_only, _git_changed_paths, _classify_settled, _eligible_run_ids, FinalHeadSeams, _FinalHeadCheck, not_pushed_record, format_final_head_ci, check_final_head_ci). Any test edit beyond import-path updates is out of scope. Also update apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_module_budgets.py (the default assertion 400 -> 350) and docs/architecture.md (the default_max_lines (400) line).
rationale: Each step lowers the module budget by 50 lines and decomposes the modules it newly catches, so modules stay small without one oversized refactor.
acceptance_criteria: default_max_lines is 350; overrides above 400 unchanged; no override added or raised; exclude list unchanged.
Each of the six modules is at most 350 lines and every new module is at most 350 lines; 'uv run python scripts/check_module_budgets.py' passes (CI needs the module-budget-change label).
Every previously public name of the six modules is still importable from its original module path; a test or import check proves it.
No behaviour change: the full unit suite passes unchanged apart from import-path updates in tests; no test is removed.
The execution notes list each split (old module -> new modules with line counts) and the modules between 301 and 350 lines (the next step's set).
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest', and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
Every new module file listed in the intent scope is at most 350 lines and the six original modules are re-export shims or reduced below 350 lines.
